title: Guest Care Category Schedule: Share of Each Affected Night Refunded
content:
# Guest care category schedule — share of each affected night refunded

**Schedule rule.** On an approved travel issue on a reservation in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category, the share of each affected night refunded depends on the issue category of the approved request: a misrepresented listing is refunded 50 percent of each affected night; an essential amenity missing is refunded 25 percent; a guest who cannot get in or a place that is unsafe or unsanitary is refunded 100 percent.

| Issue category on the approved request | Share of each affected night's price |
|---|---|
| Misrepresented (differs materially from the listing) | 50 percent |
| Amenity missing (an essential listed amenity is missing) | 25 percent |
| No access (the guest cannot get in) | 100 percent |
| Uninhabitable (unsafe or unsanitary) | 100 percent |

The category is the one recorded on the approved travel-issue request; where the stay has more than one approved, the one decided most recently.

## Illustration (hypothetical: 4 affected nights at a night price of 200.00)

| Category | Share | Nightly amount at that share |
|---|---|---|
| Misrepresented | 50 percent | 400.00 |
| Amenity missing | 25 percent | 200.00 |
| No access | 100 percent | 800.00 |
| Uninhabitable | 100 percent | 800.00 |
